posts.post: Skipping stones, a take that misses
posts.what: From a fixed view on the hill behind a yellow friend and a plank, an unseen stone is thrown and thin white rings pop up one after another far out on the sea, while a flower floats in the air; nothing else changes.
posts.recipe: one thrown simulated object, static camera, traces on the water
posts.shared: single simulated object's flight studied from a fixed camera

posts.what: A still picture of the island redrawn as a black-and-white print, the sea in hatched lines and the land as white paper; nothing on the island moves or changes.
posts.recipe: stylised artwork of the island, a still
posts.shared: a quiet still showing the island in another look

posts.what: From a fixed low view of the garden with the stone lantern in late dusk light, many white dots blink over the grass, all brightening together in pulses; they barely move and nothing else changes.
posts.recipe: fixed view, glowing specks pulse over the evening ground
posts.shared: fixed view of the evening garden with twinkling light specks
